test_create_books_has_persisted_entity_c: Book reread preserves entity/USD/2026 and all five account categories at revision zero, with no journal or lines.
test_exact_decimal_lines_persist_as_draf: Persisted 0.10 plus 0.20 equals 0.3000 on both sides; source/evidence survive, pending count is one and posted totals remain zero.
test_repeated_exact_request_returns_same: Retry returns the identical journal; book revision stays one with one journal, three lines and one audit event.
test_reused_operation_with_different_pay: Changed payload on the original key and a new key for the same source both refuse without another journal, line or event.
test_invalid_amounts_and_line_sides_cann: Noncanonical/float/boolean/negative/nonfinite/excess precision values and zero or two-sided lines refuse with zero journals/lines/events and revision zero.
test_unbalanced_and_excess_total_journal: A 0.31 credit against 0.30 debits and excessive monetary totals both refuse, leaving zero journals/lines/events.
test_sibling_entity_accounts_cannot_be_u: An account from another owned entity cannot enter this book; no journal, line or event exists.
test_foreign_administrator_cannot_read_o: A different administrator/superuser cannot read or write private books or initialize them; no accounting records are created.
test_current_membership_role_and_user_en: Reviewer/viewer, disabled membership and a freshly disabled user cannot propose journals, despite the stale original user object; no records are written.
test_stale_revision_and_actor_or_currenc: Account creation advances only its event; stale journal revision and actor/currency/posted-state hints refuse, leaving zero journals/lines and one event.
test_entry_date_must_be_real_canonical_a: Impossible dates, either adjacent out-of-period date, noncanonical text and a Python date object refuse with zero journal/line/event writes.
test_existing_book_currency_and_period_c: Exact repeated setup is unchanged; changing currency or either period boundary refuses and the original book rereads identically.
test_duplicate_account_code_and_invalid_: A duplicate account code, unknown category and empty code refuse; original book revision and event count remain zero.
test_saved_journal_lines_and_source_hist: Saved journal, line and event save/delete calls refuse; the exact original journal still reads back.
